done_when: the confirmed ask-gl-names-and-transactions spec states that an Actual of 2^46 rupees (about 70.37 lakh crore) or more is not clickable, per the owner's decision of 2026-10-03

findings.body: The new oversized-row variant says its context entry has no amount, but the unchanged context definition at lines 82–84 still says that “for every row” the context binds its exact-paise Actual, and C5a at lines 223–225 repeats that each row carries an exact-paise Actual. Those requirements cannot both be satisfied and could lead an implementation to retain the unsafe amount while claiming C5a compliance. Explicitly exempt size-limited rows in both generic context descriptions.
findings.title: Remove the contradictory requirement to sign an amount for every row

why: spec: Ask Actuals too large for exact paise are not clickable
